links.comparator_used: Independent reading by radiologists without DL-3DABUV assistance (also compared second-reading vs concurrent-reading modes)
links.outcome: Diagnostic performance of novice radiologists (AUC, specificity) and reading time
links.effect: Novices in independent reading had lower AUC and specificity than DL-3DABUV (0.68 vs 0.82, P<0.001; 57.4% vs 81.5%, P<0.001), but novice performance reached parity with DL-3DABUV in both second-reading and concurrent-reading. No significant difference in diagnostic performance between second-reading and concurrent-reading.
links.tradeoff: Second-reading took longer: concurrent reading reduced reading time by 33.6 seconds compared with second-reading (P<0.001).
links.quote: DL-3DABUV achieves diagnostic performance comparable to experienced radiologists and enhances diagnostic accuracy for novices.
